title: Everything is kept by kind, nearest to where it is first used
summary: The 293 things read from photographs of the open cabinets each get a place by rule (stow in model/kitchen.py): cleaning chemicals only under the sink, the children's things at or below the 5-year-old's shoulder, alcohol and medicine above the 8-year-old's reach, heavy things below counter height, one kind in one cabinet, and each kind as near as it fits to the range, sink, dishwasher, refrigerator or prep sink it serves. Pots go left of the range, pans and the everything drawer right of it, mixing bowls and wraps in the island, dishes over the dishwasher, glasses left of the window, food in the pantry with the snacks on its two low shelves.

rejected.value: every thing where it is today
rejected.why: the three base cabinets left of the range are where the refrigerator now stands, and the snack and dry-goods wall cabinets on the sink wall are gone; the pantry and the island did not exist
